diagnosis: Ossifying fibroma arising in hyperparathyroidism–jaw tumour syndrome
legend: High-power view of an avascular hypercellular stroma composed of bland spindled cells surrounding bony trabeculae.
Cytological features include nuclear enlargement often with preserved N:C ratios, multinucleation, perinuclear cytoplasmic clearing, and eosinophilic cell type, sometimes with a glassy quality.
It is emphasized that for parafibromin immunohistochemistry to be considered negative there should be an internal positive control in non-neoplastic cells including non-neoplastic parathyroid tissue.
